raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`draft_lm_head_quantization` only applies when the drafter shares the target's `lm_head`. A drafter that ships its own head (e.g. `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA`, whose head differs from the target's) is rejected with a `ValueError`, so its bf16 head is read in full on every draft step.

This PR quantizes the drafter's own head instead in that case, with the same online methods (`fp8`: per-row weight / per-token activation scales; `nvfp4`: weight-only W4A16). The shared-head path is unchanged; the head selection moves into `resolve_draft_lm_head` so it can be tested directly.

As with the shared case, the bf16 source head stays resident as the source for `refresh_quantized_lm_heads` / draft weight updates, so the copy adds memory (307 MB per rank for MiniMax-M3 at TP4) rather than saving it.

## E2E (MI355X, MiniMax-M3-MXFP4, TP4, EAGLE3-GQA K=3, `draft_lm_head_quantization: fp8`)

Base: vLLM nightly `8e2beaa3` with the MiniMax-M3 model code from main `4643f41` + #62509 + #62614 + #62846, FFN monokernel on (`--monokernel`, plus two local commits that let it take #62509's FP8 projections); the baseline is the same image without this PR. AgenticX: InferenceX recipe `minimaxm3/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml`, 3600 s, synthetic acceptance (AL 2.78), baseline and this PR run at the same time on the two GPU halves of one node. Three baseline runs spread 0.1% (throughput), 0.8% (P50), 3% (P90), 0.7% (TPOT).

| Conc | Throughput/GPU (tok/s) | P50 interactivity | P90 interactivity | Mean TPOT |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 24 | 41,332 → 41,446 (+0.3%) | 192.9 → 197.4 (+2.3%) | 115.7 → 117.3 (+1.4%) | 5.79 → 5.69 ms (−1.7%) |

The draft head is 614 MB per rank in bf16 and is read three times per step; the fp8 copy halves that read.

**Accuracy and acceptance (GSM8K)**, InferenceX `gsm8k.yaml`, 5-shot, all 1,319 questions, real EAGLE3 acceptance (AL = 1 + 3 · accepted / drafted over the whole run):

| | strict-match | flexible-extract | acceptance length |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline | 95.45% | 95.38% | 3.32 |
| this PR | 96.21% | 96.13% | 3.38 |

Standard error ±0.55%; acceptance length varies by about ±0.03 between runs of the same image.

## Test plan

- `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_draft_lm_head.py`: own-head drafter gets a quantized copy of its own head (not the target's); without quantization it keeps its head; quantization without any head raises (7 passed, 4 skipped on MI355X: nvfp4 cases).
- MiniMax-M3 EAGLE3-GQA serving with `draft_lm_head_quantization: fp8` (AgenticX and GSM8K above).

+def _drafter(head: torch.nn.Module | None, has_own: bool) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    drafter = torch.nn.Module()
+    if head is not None:
+        drafter.lm_head = head
+    drafter.has_own_lm_head = has_own
+    return drafter
+
+
+@requires_cuda
+def test_own_head_drafter_quantizes_its_own_head(
+    default_vllm_config, dist_init, monkeypatch
+):
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.utils import resolve_draft_lm_head
+
+    target, own = _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=0), _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=1)
+    drafter = _drafter(own, has_own=True)
+    resolve_draft_lm_head(drafter, torch.nn.Module(), target, "fp8")
+
+    assert drafter.lm_head is not own and drafter.lm_head is not target
+    assert drafter.lm_head.weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+    logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(VOCAB)
+    hidden = torch.randn(256, HIDDEN, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    out = logits_processor(drafter.lm_head, hidden).float()
+    own_ref = logits_processor(own, hidden).float()
+    target_ref = logits_processor(target, hidden).float()
+    # the copy follows the drafter's head, not the target's
+    assert (out - own_ref).norm() / own_ref.norm() < 0.05
+    assert (out - target_ref).norm() / target_ref.norm() > 0.5
+
+

+def test_own_head_drafter_unquantized_keeps_its_head(

+
+    target, own = _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=0), _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=1)
+    drafter = _drafter(own, has_own=True)
+    resolve_draft_lm_head(drafter, torch.nn.Module(), target, None)
+    assert drafter.lm_head is own
+

+    """Point the drafter at its lm_head: the target's when it shares one,
+    otherwise its own; with `quantization`, a quantized copy of that head."""

+        eagle_model.lm_head = draft_head

+        # eagle_model.lm_head, so the per-layer copies need fixing up too.
+        layers = getattr(draft_inner, "layers", None)
